issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted) specifies a third dependency kind, `verifies`, to diagnose inverted verification gates structurally, and no open bead covers it. Implement `verifies` as a declared edge kind; add an advisory diagnostic that reports any `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead; never reject such an edge at insert time (deliberate baseline gates are legitimate) and never infer the relationship from issue titles. Extend dependency schema and validation, add field-guide entries (`bead schema explain`), update help-snapshot digests, and emit audit events for the new edge mutations per the engineering rules (atomic, auditable, concurrency-tested). Include cycle-check interaction tests and update `research/specs/` before any compatibility claim.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand

issue.description:
AGENTS.md states NEEDLE compatibility is defined by `research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md` and that compatibility must never be claimed without passing the corresponding conformance suite, yet no open bead or visible test target locks that contract (the BR-T27 NEEDLE consumer canary covers only the claim-epoch slice). Audit the spec's contract surface — command names, exit codes, `list --json` JSONL output shape, claim/fencing behavior the fleet depends on — against existing tests, add a tracked conformance test target for the uncovered behaviors, and wire it into the Definition of Done / CI gate so the compatibility claim is enforced by the suite rather than asserted.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand

Plan: docs/plan/plan.md §12 R035 (line 3585) -- "The initial check shipped ahead of that convergence and currently emits prose, so reason codes, a machine-readable id list ... remain outstanding."

## Observed (plan-vs-built audit 2026-10-10)
`bead doctor --scope store --json` lists checks [workspace_config, database_integrity, stale_in_progress, uuid_divergence, temporary_files]; the stale_in_progress check carries details.reason_codes and per-issue remedies, but no assignment-held check with reason codes or id list was observed there. Prior bead c3ede36c (closed) shipped the prose check.

## Scope
Emit the assignment-held (open + assignee) diagnosis with the shared R001/R034 reason-code vocabulary, a machine-readable id list in details, and the exact `bead update <id> --clear-assignee` remedy per issue. Advisory only; doctor never clears an assignee. Do NOT design a "declare intentional hold" mechanism (separate decision).

## Done when
In a temp workspace with one open bead assigned via `bead update <id> --assignee x`: `bead doctor --json` contains a check whose details.reason_codes is non-empty and whose id list contains that bead, and remedy equals `bead update <id> --clear-assignee`; a test fails if the check is removed; fmt, clippy -D warnings and tests pass.
